title: Evidence
description: A record supporting a specific claim. Evidence is the only thing that makes an Amasario claim assertable, so two rules are enforced structurally here: every record must state the claim it supports, and each evidence class has its own required fields so that a record cannot claim to be stronger evidence than it is. A per-type conditional in allOf rejects a record that names a class without supplying that class's distinguishing fields.

id.description: The evidence identifier, unique within the producing document and referenced by every claim that relies on it.

type.description: The evidence class. An unrecognised term requires the consumer to treat the evidence as UNKNOWN rather than to infer a class, because inferring a class would attribute evidentiary weight the record never claimed.

claim.description: The exact claim this record supports, stated as a sentence. Required, and required to be specific: the purpose of this field is that a reader can decide whether the record actually bears on the claim, which is impossible if the field says only 'provenance'.

supportsRelationships.description: Identifiers of the dependency edges or impact findings this evidence supports, when the evidence is scoped to specific relationships rather than to the document as a whole.

observedAt.description: When this record was observed. Distinct from any timestamp the underlying source reports.

boundary.description: The network and ledger boundary of the observation, when known. Required for every evidence class that is derived from network observation, which is enforced by rule provenance/evidence-traceability.

digest.description: A digest over whatever the evidence record points at, when the evidence is content-addressable.

repository.description: SOURCE evidence: the repository the revision was read from.

revision.description: SOURCE evidence: the exact revision observed.

toolchain.description: BUILD evidence: the toolchain identity the build used.

configurationDigest.description: BUILD evidence: the digest of the build configuration.

artifactType.description: ARTIFACT evidence: the artifact class the digest was computed over. References artifact.schema.json rather than restating its enumeration.

contractId.description: WASM, DEPLOYMENT or EVENT evidence: the contract address the observation concerns.

transactionHash.description: TRANSACTION, DEPLOYMENT or EVENT evidence: the transaction the observation derives from.

ledger.description: TRANSACTION, DEPLOYMENT or EVENT evidence: the ledger the observation derives from.

successful.description: TRANSACTION evidence: whether the transaction succeeded. Required for this class so that a failed transaction cannot be cited as evidence of an effect.

attestationId.description: ATTESTATION evidence: the identifier of the attestation record this evidence refers to.

observationNote.description: OBSERVATION evidence: what was observed, stated factually. This class asserts presence only and must not be used to assert an effect.
